_comment: THE PIN TABLE. One place. Every model RichOS may download is listed here with the exact
byte count and the exact sha256 of the bytes we mean, plus where each hash came from.
A hash fetched from the same server it authenticates is not a check, so nothing in this
file is ever refreshed at run time. It is source. Changing a line here is a commit.
provenance is a LIST because agreement between independent witnesses is the whole value:
x-linked-etag   HuggingFace publishes the sha256 of every LFS file in this response header.
ceo-disk        shasum -a 256 over the CEO's own copy under ~/Models/Whisper.
wiki-record     a hash already written down in richos-hq wiki, recorded before this table.
A single-witness pin is honest but weaker; the field says which so nobody has to guess.
As of 2026-08-31, five of the six are confirmed against a real file on this machine.
small.en-q5_1 is the exception and its `witness` field says so in as many words.
Read by lib/model-catalog.js and by tools/richos-hud/fetch-dictation-models.sh. The test
suite asserts those two readers agree, so the shell copy can never drift from this file.
2026-09-10: the `toolchain` block below joins it. Weights were pinned here and the BINARY that
reads them was not, which is the exposure the whisper settings decision table named in its §4.
It lives in this file and not a second one on purpose: two registries of truth is how the
second unpinned consumer happened in the first place.
THE REFERENCE BUILD — the one every decode setting RichOS ships was measured against.
This is NOT a requirement and it deliberately cannot be one. `whisper-cli` arrives from
Homebrew, so its sha256 is a property of an arch, an OS version and a bottle revision; a
source pin that every machine but this one fails is a pin nobody keeps. What IS enforced is
a per-machine trust-on-first-use lock (~/.config/richos/whisper-toolchain.lock.json), and a
mismatch against THAT warns loudly and names both identities. A mismatch against a MODEL pin
above refuses, because that table does have authority over what the bytes should be.
`whisperCppVersion` is what a run's `--version` is compared to, so that a transcript produced
on a different build is attributed to that build rather than to the table's numbers.
MEASURED, not transcribed from a formula file, 2026-09-10 on this M4:
shasum -a 256 /opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli
/opt/homebrew/Cellar/whisper-cpp/1.9.1/bin/whisper-cli --version
exit 0, stdout: whisper.cpp version: 1.9.1
/opt/homebrew/Cellar/whisper-cpp/1.8.3/bin/whisper-cli --version
exit 0, stdout EMPTY, stderr: error: unknown argument: --version
That second measurement is why the sha256 is the identity and the version string is a label:
1.8.3 REJECTS --version and still exits 0, so a probe trusting the exit code sees success
and an empty version — indistinguishable from a build that simply has none.

knownOtherBuilds.note: Also on this machine. Does NOT support --version: exits 0 with empty stdout and 'error: unknown argument: --version' on stderr. The substitution the toolchain test fires against.

models.note: Smallest English model. Not used by any shipping capability; pinned so an offer can exist.
The bundle-a-small-model candidate. Accuracy never measured on this project.

models.witness: SINGLE WITNESS — no copy of this file exists on any machine here to check against. It is the only pin in this table nothing but HuggingFace vouches for. Fetch one and re-check before this model is ever offered.
models.note: Quantized small.en. A low-disk fallback; not a shipping default.

models.witness: shasum agrees on TWO independent copies (~/Models/Whisper and ~/.config/open-wispr/models), 2026-08-31; wiki/local-dictation.md recorded c6138d6d… before this table existed
models.note: Voice conversation + the Faster dictation mode. Three independent witnesses agree.
config.js DEFAULT_TIER -> DEFAULT_MODEL since 2026-09-10 (CEO decision page 10): call transcription AND the More accurate dictation mode, one file for both. The largest thing a first run downloads.

OPT-IN since 2026-09-10 (CEO decision page 10) - it was config.js DEFAULT_MODEL until then and is deliberately NOT removed from this table, because a model with no pin is a model RichOS refuses to download. `richos-service fetch-model large-v3-turbo` is the path to it. The largest thing RichOS can download.
